decisions.reason: Dietary supplement range builds on the firm's consumer health and quality capabilities, so absorptive capacity supports learning from early results.
Skin and hair supplement is adjacent to the firm's consumer health activities and can be sold through existing pharmacy channels, so the firm retains enough absorptive capacity to manage it.
Joint health supplement aligns with OTC pain and mobility knowledge, making early results interpretable and improvable.
Mushroom-based immune supplement requires botanical and fungal knowledge outside the firm's pharmaceutical absorptive capacity, so it is difficult to evaluate and improve.
Generic blood pressure medication is core to existing generics expertise, and strong quality-control knowledge allows the firm to correct the valsartan problem.
OTC migraine triptan fits the firm's core OTC medicine capabilities and shows no negative early results, so keeping is consistent with absorptive capacity.
